phase: A quiet day after the six-lead spike: $205 of $300 spent (68%), 21 leads frozen, zero booked calls known — and the watchdog itself went silent last night (day 237 AM)
headline: Good morning. Yesterday was the opposite of Wednesday: the campaign spent, the leads did not come. Twenty-four hourly watchdog runs all read 21 lifetime leads — not one new form all day — while lifetime spend rolled from $187 to $205.24 (68% of the $300 plan) at a blended $9.77 CPL. The watchdog says it plainly: spend is now past the $150-200 floor where CPL becomes a fair read, and the metric that actually decides this — cost per booked call — still "cannot be evaluated yet" because no CRM source is connected. Eight days of that sentence now. Then a new fault: the watchdog's last email landed at 19:36Z (12:36 PM PT) and nothing since — six missed hourly runs overnight, on the one campaign that only the watchdog is watching. Either the Mac slept or the task died; either way the $300 Plan ran unobserved through the PT afternoon and evening. What did not change: compliance is 0/7 on day seven of live dialing. The six CA/TX phone numbers from Wednesday are still the six CA/TX phone numbers, b3 (TX telephone-solicitor registration) and b7 (CA producer-license #) are still the two items the last account was banned over, and there is still no written word from Frankie anywhere in the mailbox — nine days now. The autonomy picture is now precise: this AM brief fired on-cron at 01:01Z with Mac access for the third straight morning; the PM brief fired 14:05Z yesterday and wrote nothing; the cofounder sweep fired 00:45Z today and wrote nothing; meeting-ingest failed at 00:02Z for the ninth day, 15 days stale. One lane of four reaches the disk. Two moves, one each. Frankie: the numbers or the one-line state rule — nine days is the whole point. Chitraksh: get the watchdog back up and pointed at a CRM count, because with $95 left the next decision is double-or-kill and there is nothing to decide it on.
source: Reconstructed from a live Gmail sweep of hanfluxai@gmail.com through 2026-09-04T01:30Z plus the on-disk workspace. The Meta→CRM hourly sync has been failing since Aug 27 23:47Z and nobody has re-checked it in eight days. The R4 notify gate is $240; at $25/day that is Sunday. When it fires, the choice is double the budget or kill the campaign, and right now the only inputs are a CPL that flatters volume and a digest whose numbers disagree with Meta. Today: connect any CRM count — a sheet the booking flow appends to is enough — and push one of the 21 leads end-to-end so there is one real booked-call cost before the $240 line.
